tagline: Leading global aerospace and defense technology provider delivering space systems, military aircraft, and advanced solutions to U.S. and international customers.
hero_kpi_rationale: The strong reliance on the U.S. government (84% of sales in 2025) is a key factor directly influencing the company's strategy and performance, making it sensitive to defense spending priorities and changes in government budgetary policy.

kpis.name: U.S. Government Sales Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue generated from sales to the U.S. government.
kpis.description: Represents the company's dependence on its primary customer, the U.S. government, and its influence on defense spending priorities.

kpis.name: Proceeds from Disposal of IMS Unit
kpis.explanation: Amount received from the sale of the Immersive Mission Solutions (IMS) operating unit on May 24, 2025.
kpis.description: Proceeds from the sale of the training and software communications unit serving U.S. government customers, completed on May 24, 2025.
kpis.signal: Disposal of a non-core business to optimize the portfolio.

kpis.name: Pre-Tax Gain on Sale of IMS
kpis.explanation: Pre-tax profit realized from the sale of the Immersive Mission Solutions unit on May 24, 2025.
kpis.description: Pre-tax profit recorded following the sale of the training and software communications business, completed on May 24, 2025.
kpis.signal: One-time positive impact on operating results.

kpis.name: OBBBA Defense Funding Allocation
kpis.explanation: Amount allocated for defense spending under the OBBBA law of July 4, 2025, including air defense, munitions, strategic deterrence, and supply chain.
kpis.description: Funds allocated by the OBBBA law (July 4, 2025) for air and missile defense, munitions, strategic deterrence, shipbuilding, and supply chain, available through September 30, 2029.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in government defense investments.

kpis.name: FY26 Continuing Resolution Funding End Date
kpis.explanation: Final funding deadline for the federal government before new appropriations must be enacted for fiscal year 2026.
kpis.description: Government continuing resolution expires on January 30, 2026. FY 2026 appropriations have not yet been approved, creating uncertainty around funding levels and payment timing.
kpis.signal: Risk of uncertainty regarding government funding and payment delays.

kpis.name: AI-Integrated Cloud Offerings Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: Measures the integration and adoption of AI capabilities in the company's cloud offerings.
kpis.signal: Indicator of AI adoption in cloud solutions.

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
kpis.explanation: Total volume of requests made through artificial intelligence application programming interfaces.
kpis.description: Quantifies customer usage of AI services, reflecting adoption and integration of these technologies.

risks.title: Reliance on U.S. Government
risks.score_rationale: 84% of sales come from the U.S. government. The government has the ability to delay, modify, or cancel programs, and changes in strategy or budget priorities could have a material impact on financial results.

risks.title: Government Contract Risks
risks.score_rationale: Contracts with the U.S. government may be modified, delayed, or canceled. Recent executive orders aim to reform acquisition processes and could create a more complex regulatory environment.

risks.title: Federal Budget and Funding Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: FY 2026 appropriations have not been approved. The government is operating under a continuing resolution until January 30, 2026. Funding delays or reductions could impact payments and programs.

risks.title: B-21 Program Risks
risks.score_rationale: Recognized losses of $1.56 billion (Q4 2023) and an additional $477 million (Q1 2025) on LRIP options. Ongoing discussions on production acceleration create additional uncertainty.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Inflationary Pressures
risks.score_rationale: Inflationary pressures, supply chain disruptions, high borrowing costs, and potential impacts from trade tariffs. The government may reduce defense spending in response.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in defense and aerospace markets may reduce contract opportunities and increase pricing pressures.

risks.title: Regulatory and Policy Risks
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing executive orders to reform defense acquisition processes and reduce government spending. Some orders are subject to legal challenges.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Heightened geopolitical tensions (Ukraine, Middle East, Western Pacific) create increased demand but also uncertainty regarding future priorities and potential impacts.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions related to artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided 10-K excerpts.
